title: The plan treats the OpenAI-compatible response `model` string as an immutable version, but the vendor-neutral
text: The plan treats the OpenAI-compatible response `model` string as an immutable version, but the vendor-neutral seam cannot establish that it is not a mutable alias. It also stores only a shared client’s most-recent response value, which is unsafe for the parallel precision calls. Specify a per-request immutable-version attestation/validation mechanism, or mark campaigns without one inadmissible for AC8/AC9; record and compare the value for every inference request.
